instruction:
Three-software CAE flow: AutoCAD -> SolidWorks -> Abaqus/CAE. No init files are provided; start from blank files.

Chain evidence requirement: use the design token EW_ACAD_SW_ABQ_01. In AutoCAD, add a readable label containing EW_ACAD_SW_ABQ_01 and AUTOCAD_TO_SOLIDWORKS on a CHAIN layer in stage1_profile.dxf. In SolidWorks, keep EW_ACAD_SW_ABQ_01, FROM_stage1_profile.dxf, and SOLIDWORKS_TO_ABAQUS encoded in the part/custom properties or STEP export metadata so the text of stage2_geometry.step contains them. In Abaqus/CAE, create at least one model, part, instance, set, surface, job description, or other native name containing both EW_ACAD_SW_ABQ_01 and IMPORTED_FROM_stage2_geometry.step, so the final CAE file carries evidence that Abaqus consumed the SolidWorks STEP handoff.

1. In AutoCAD, use drawing tools to create the 2D profile and save it as C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage1_profile.dxf. Draw a 120 mm x 80 mm rectangle on layer OUTLINE. Draw four D8 circular holes on layer HOLE with centers at (15,15), (105,15), (15,65), and (105,65). Draw one centered 40 mm x 12 mm rounded slot on layer CUTOUT.
2. In SolidWorks, import stage1_profile.dxf and create the 3D part. Extrude the profile to 6 mm thickness, cut the four holes and center slot through the part, add 1 mm outer chamfers, and export C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage2_geometry.step.
3. In Abaqus/CAE, import stage2_geometry.step and create the finite-element model. Use the model name Model-PlateStatic. Define material Steel with E=210000 MPa and nu=0.3, create a solid section using Steel, and assign it to the plate. Create a Static General analysis step named Step-Static. Create sets named FIXED_HOLES and LOAD_HOLES. Use a coarse first-order linear solid mesh for the plate holes and slot, using C3D8R where practical or coarse C3D4 where needed; do not use quadratic elements or dense hole/slot refinement. Create a boundary condition named BC-FixedHoles that constrains the two left holes. Create a load named Load-RightHoles that applies an approximately 800 N tensile load to the two right holes. Submit the job named Job-PlateStatic and wait for the analysis to complete.
4. Required deliverables on the Desktop: C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage1_profile.dxf, C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage2_geometry.step, C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-PlateStatic.cae, and C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-PlateStatic.odb. Do not create extra STEP, DXF, CAE, or ODB deliverables.

 First use AutoCAD to create the DXF profile, then use SolidWorks to import the DXF and export the STEP file, then use Abaqus/CAE to import that STEP file, build the finite-element model, submit the job, and save the CAE and ODB deliverables.
